about: Model verdicts on source against tree for hse-eh40 (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: The footnote to the Chromium (VI) process generated limit is not kept with the table but in a separate text section, joined to the running header.
findings.evidence: tree: "Table 1: List of approved workplace exposure limits 1 ‘Process generated’ refers to exposures to Chromium (VI) Compounds"
